remote_commands:
date -u '+observed_at=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
printf 'hostname='; hostname
id
uname -srmo
if [ -r /proc/device-tree/model ]; then printf 'board='; tr -d '\000' < /proc/device-tree/model; printf '\n'; fi
sed -n '/^PRETTY_NAME=/p' /etc/os-release
printf 'usb_inventory\n'
if command -v lsusb >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsusb; else printf 'lsusb=missing\n'; fi
for p in /sys/bus/usb/devices/*/idVendor; do
  [ -r "$p" ] || continue
  d=${p%/idVendor}
  printf 'usb_device=%s\n' "$d"
  for f in idVendor idProduct manufacturer product serial; do
    if [ -r "$d/$f" ]; then printf '%s=' "$f"; cat "$d/$f"; fi
  done
done
printf 'alsa_cards\n'
if [ -r /proc/asound/cards ]; then cat /proc/asound/cards; else printf 'cards=missing_or_denied\n'; fi
printf 'alsa_pcm\n'
if [ -r /proc/asound/pcm ]; then cat /proc/asound/pcm; else printf 'pcm=missing_or_denied\n'; fi
for c in /sys/class/sound/card[0-9]*; do
  [ -e "$c" ] || continue
  printf 'sound_device=%s path=' "$c"; readlink -f "$c/device"
done
printf 'audio_nodes\n'
if [ -d /dev/snd ]; then
  ls -l /dev/snd
  for p in /dev/snd/*; do
    [ -e "$p" ] && [ ! -d "$p" ] || continue
    r=no; w=no
    [ ! -r "$p" ] || r=yes
    [ ! -w "$p" ] || w=yes
    printf 'node=%s readable=%s writable=%s\n' "$p" "$r" "$w"
  done
else printf 'snd_directory=missing\n'; fi
scope: read-only identity, USB/sysfs, proc ALSA and metadata/access checks; no PCM/control open, no service start, no permission changes
